checks.independent_check: At p=2, J0={M:det M mod8 in {1,7}} is a proper closed subgroup of GL_g(Z2) yet surjects mod4: multiplying a lift by diag(5,1,...,1) changes the relevant determinant lift without changing mod4. This disproves the isolated mod-p^2 lifting sentence. The actual construction additionally surjects to G/X, and every X element is a 2^a-th power with a>=1. For the actual image J, squares of lifts of 1+2Eij and commutators generate the trace-zero subspace of the mod8 congruence kernel. Thus a proper mod8 image would have index2 and contain all squares, hence X, contradicting JX=G. Full mod8 surjectivity then lifts by deeper congruence squaring and closedness.
checks.impact_and_repair: The omitted inference is locally false but the full printed construction hypotheses prove its needed conclusion. Repair the proof using both finite quotients. No admissible geometric counterexample or failed main monodromy claim; Minor reflects actual dependency, not ease of repair alone.

checks.independent_check: For the reduced-image reading, the g=2,r=3,ell=7 self-dual Lagrangian correspondence has degree(7+1)(7^2+1)=400. A proper full-monodromy curve B can be chosen by the stated Lefschetz/Satake construction, and C=T(B)_red is irreducible. At a generic End=Z point the reverse incidences give coefficient at least400 of B in the correspondence cycle, while the reduced support gives coefficient1; hence reduced degrees need not multiply. This is conditional on the cited geometric existence/compactification inputs, and C is not claimed to satisfy all additional main-proof monodromy hypotheses. The source also uses labelled disjoint unions, admitting the ordinary cycle convention under which the projection formula is valid. The reduced-image definition in characteristic p does not automatically settle the characteristic-zero convention.

The needed proper-compactification extension inputs remain a limit. The ambiguity and admissible cycle reading prevent a confirmed Major claim.

This controls the isolated field inference only, not the full maximal-monodromy modular existence lemma. Taking the normal closure also makes the original point nonprimitive. Actual Zywina Theorem1.1 gives density-one bounded index, and Section1.2 makes its constant a function of the arithmetic and geometric generic images H,Hg; neither asserts the specialization field is Galois.

If the selected parameter is primitive over L, then L embeds in the point field, ensuring the degree lower bound. Existence of arbitrarily large Galois L with unchanged generic images and the claimed PSL construction were not independently established. Strong lemma remains unproved by the inspected argument; main existence theorem not refuted.
